title: Morose delectation
html_source: Delectatio morosa is “the pleasure taken in a sinful thought of imagination even without desiring it.”.

ly's lane that night: the tanyard smells. 

White thy fambles, red thy gan 
And thy quarrons dainty is. 
Couch a hogshead with me then. 
In the darkmans clip and kiss.

anchor.suffix: Aquinas tunbelly calls this, frate porcospino. Unfallen Adam rode and not rutted. Call away let him: thy quarrons dainty is. Language no whit worse than his. Monkwords, marybeads
